table.retrieve:
SELECT /*opening balance*/
	glvochcode=Null,
	debit=CASE WHEN b.bal >= 0 THEN b.bal ELSE 0 END,
	credit=CASE WHEN b.bal >= 0 THEN 0 ELSE ABS(b.bal) END,
	date = :ad_startDate, 
	type = SPACE(100),
	remarks='Opening Balance',
	acc=SPACE(100),
	accounthead=SPACE(100),
	priority=-1
FROM
	(SELECT bal=sum(Debit-Credit) 
	FROM VirtualGl
	WHERE acccode in (select acccode from accounts where acccode IN (:ai_acccode)) and
		date < :ad_startDate) B
UNION ALL
SELECT /*CashierShift  entry for excess / short cash in respective account for which the shift is made*/
	glvochcode=CS.CashierShiftCode,
	debit=CASE WHEN CS.DiffAmt > 0 THEN ABS(CS.DiffAmt) ELSE 0 END,
	credit=CASE WHEN CS.DiffAmt > 0 THEN 0.00 ELSE ABS(CS.DiffAmt) END,
	date = CS.ClosedOn,
	type = 'CSHIFT-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), CS.CashierShiftCode))),
	remarks=CS.Remarks,
	acc=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = CASE WHEN CS.DiffAmt > 0 THEN CS.CashAccCode ELSE CS.DiffTransferedTo END),
	accounthead=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = CASE WHEN CS.DiffAmt > 0 THEN CS.DiffTransferedTo ELSE CS.CashAccCode END),
	priority=0
FROM
	CashierShift CS
WHERE
	CS.DiffAmt <> 0 AND
	CS.ShiftStatus = 'C' AND
	CS.CashAccCode in (select acccode from accounts where acccode IN (:ai_acccode)) and
	CS.ClosedOn >= :ad_StartDate and
	CS.ClosedOn <= :ad_endDate
UNION ALL
SELECT /*CashierShift entry for amount transferred account if respective account is used for amount transfer*/
	glvochcode=CS.CashierShiftCode,
	debit=CS.AmtTransfered,
	credit=0.00,
	date = CS.ClosedOn,
	type = 'CSHIFT-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), CS.CashierShiftCode))),
	remarks=CS.Remarks,
	acc=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = CS.AmtTransferedTo),
	accounthead=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = CS.CashAccCode),
	priority=0
FROM
	CashierShift CS
WHERE
	CS.AmtTransfered > 0 AND
	CS.ShiftStatus = 'C' AND
	CS.AmtTransferedTo in (select acccode from accounts where acccode IN (:ai_acccode)) and
	CS.ClosedOn >= :ad_StartDate and
	CS.ClosedOn <= :ad_endDate
UNION ALL
SELECT /*CashierShift entry for amount transferred account if respective account is used for amount transfer*/
	glvochcode=CS.CashierShiftCode,
	debit=0.00,
	credit=CS.AmtTransfered,
	date = CS.ClosedOn,
	type = 'CSHIFT-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), CS.CashierShiftCode))),
	remarks=CS.Remarks,
	acc=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = CS.CashAccCode),
	accounthead=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = CS.AmtTransferedTo),
	priority=0
FROM
	CashierShift CS
WHERE
	CS.AmtTransfered > 0 AND
	CS.ShiftStatus = 'C' AND
	CS.CashAccCode in (select acccode from accounts where acccode IN (:ai_acccode)) and
	CS.ClosedOn >= :ad_StartDate and
	CS.ClosedOn <= :ad_endDate
UNION ALL
SELECT /*Transaction Details debit=credit and credit=debit*/
	glvochcode=h.glvochcode,
	debit=d.credit,
	credit=d.debit,
	date = h.date,
	type = RTRIM(LTRIM(VC.SHORTNAME)) + '-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), h.glvochcode))),
	remarks=d.remarks,
	acc=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = h.acccode),
	accounthead=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = d.acccode),
	priority=0
FROM
	glheader h,
	gldetail d,
	vochercategory vc,
	accounts a
WHERE
	h.posted = 'Y' and
	h.glvochcode = d.glvochcode and
	h.vochcatcode = vc.vochcatcode and
	vc.journalvoucher = 0 and
	h.acccode in (:ai_acccode) and
	h.acccode <> d.acccode and 
	d.acccode = a.acccode and
	h.date >= :ad_StartDate and
	h.date <= :ad_endDate
UNION ALL

FROM

	vochercategory vc
WHERE
	h.posted = 'Y' and
	h.glvochcode = d.glvochcode and
	h.vochcatcode = vc.vochcatcode and
	vc.journalvoucher = 1 and
 	d.acccode IN (:ai_acccode) and 
	h.date >= :ad_StartDate and
	h.date <= :ad_endDate

SELECT 
	glvochcode=NULL,
	debit = ISNULL(SUM(S.Amt), 0),
	credit = 0,
	date = :ad_EndDate,
	type = 'CSH-SALE',
	remarks='Total Invoices: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT COUNT(SaleInvCode) FROM saleledger WHERE saleledger.cashacccode = s.cashacccode and  salecatcode = 3 and posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) + 
			' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT MIN(SaleInvCode) FROM saleledger WHERE saleledger.cashacccode = s.cashacccode and  salecatcode = 3 and posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) +
			'-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT MAX(SaleInvCode) FROM saleledger WHERE saleledger.cashacccode = s.cashacccode and  salecatcode = 3 and posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) + ')',
	acc=(SELECT MAX(name) FROM accounts WHERE s.cashacccode = accounts.acccode),
	accounthead='Cash Sale (' + (SELECT MAX(name) FROM accounts WHERE s.cashacccode = accounts.acccode) + ')',
	priority=1
FROM
	(SELECT h.cashacccode, amt=ISNULL(Round(SUM(d.looseqty * d.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (d.looseqty * 
				(d.saleprice - d.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * d.discperc)) * 
				d.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (SUM((d.looseqty * 
				(d.saleprice - d.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * d.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * h.discperc)) -
				h.flatdisc) * (h.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
			Round( SUM((d.looseqty * (d.saleprice - d.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * d.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * h.discperc)) + 
				h.misccharges + h.salestax - h.flatdisc, 0), 0)
	FROM
		saleledger h,
		saledetail d
	WHERE
		h.saleinvcode = d.saleinvcode and
		h.salecatcode = 3 and
		h.cashacccode IN (:ai_acccode) AND
		h.posted = 'Y' and 
		h.accountfor='Y' and
		h.date >= :ad_StartDate and
		h.date <= :ad_EndDate
	GROUP BY h.saleinvcode, h.cashacccode, 
		 h.salecatcode, 
		 h.date,
		 h.discperc,
		 h.misccharges,
		 h.salestax,
		 h.InvGSTPerc1,
		 h.flatdisc) S 
GROUP BY S.cashacccode
HAVING SUM(S.Amt) <> 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	glvochcode=NULL,
	debit = ISNULL(SUM(S.Amt), 0),
	credit = 0,
	date = :ad_EndDate,
	type = 'CR-SALE',
	remarks='Total Invoices: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT COUNT(SaleInvCode) FROM saleledger WHERE saleledger.cashacccode = s.cashacccode and  salecatcode = 1 and posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) + 
			' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT MIN(SaleInvCode) FROM saleledger WHERE saleledger.cashacccode = s.cashacccode and salecatcode = 1 and posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) +
			'-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT MAX(SaleInvCode) FROM saleledger WHERE saleledger.cashacccode = s.cashacccode and salecatcode = 1 and posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) + ')',
	acc=(SELECT MAX(name) FROM accounts WHERE s.cashacccode = accounts.acccode),
	accounthead='Cr. Sale Immediate Cash (' + (SELECT MAX(name) FROM accounts WHERE s.cashacccode = accounts.acccode) + ')',
	priority=2
FROM
	(SELECT h.cashacccode, amt=ISNULL(Round(SUM(d.looseqty * d.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (d.looseqty * 
				(d.saleprice - d.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * d.discperc)) * 
				d.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (SUM((d.looseqty * 
				(d.saleprice - d.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * d.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * h.discperc)) -
				h.flatdisc) * (h.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
			Round( SUM((d.looseqty * (d.saleprice - d.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * d.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * h.discperc)) + 
				h.misccharges + h.salestax - h.flatdisc, 0), 0)
	FROM
		saleledger h,
		saledetail d
	WHERE
		h.saleinvcode = d.saleinvcode and
		h.salecatcode = 1 and
		h.cashacccode IN (:ai_acccode) AND
		h.posted = 'Y' and 
		h.accountfor='Y' and
		h.date >= :ad_StartDate and
		h.date <= :ad_EndDate
	GROUP BY h.saleinvcode, h.cashacccode, 
		 h.salecatcode, 
		 h.date,
		 h.discperc,
		 h.misccharges,
		 h.salestax,
		 h.InvGSTPerc1,
		 h.flatdisc) S 
	GROUP BY s.cashacccode
	HAVING SUM(S.Amt) > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	glvochcode=NULL,
	debit = ISNULL(SUM(S.Amt), 0),
	credit = 0,
	date = :ad_EndDate,
	type = 'CSH-SALE',
	remarks='Total Invoices: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT COUNT(SaleInvCode) FROM saleledger WHERE saleledger.cashacccode = s.cashacccode and  salecatcode in (1,2) and posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and amt <> 0 and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) + 
			' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT MIN(SaleInvCode) FROM saleledger WHERE saleledger.cashacccode = s.cashacccode and  salecatcode IN (1, 2) and posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and amt <> 0 and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) +
			'-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT MAX(SaleInvCode) FROM saleledger WHERE saleledger.cashacccode = s.cashacccode and  salecatcode IN (1, 2) and posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and amt <> 0 and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) + ')',
	acc=(SELECT MAX(name) FROM accounts WHERE s.cashacccode = accounts.acccode),
	accounthead='Recvd during Cr. Sale Cr. (' + (SELECT MAX(name) FROM accounts WHERE s.cashacccode = accounts.acccode) + ')',
	priority=3
FROM
	(SELECT h.cashacccode, amt=ISNULL(sum(h.amt), 0) + ISNULL(SUM(h.cashcharged), 0)
	FROM
		saleledger h
	WHERE
		h.salecatcode IN (1, 2) and
		h.posted = 'Y' and 
		h.accountfor='Y' and 
		h.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_EndDate AND
		(h.PaymentAccCode IN (:ai_acccode) OR h.cashacccode in (:ai_acccode)) 
	GROUP BY H.cashacccode) S
	GROUP BY s.cashacccode
	HAVING SUM(S.Amt) > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	glvochcode=NULL,
	Debit  = 0,
	Credit = ISNULL(SUM(S.Amt), 0),
	date = :ad_EndDate,
	type = 'CSH-SR',
	remarks='Total Invoices: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT COUNT(SRInvCode) FROM srledger WHERE srledger.cashacccode = s.cashacccode and  srcatcode = 8 and posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) + 
			' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT MIN(SrInvCode) FROM srledger WHERE srledger.cashacccode = s.cashacccode and  srcatcode = 8 and posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) +
			'-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT MAX(SrInvCode) FROM srledger WHERE srledger.cashacccode = s.cashacccode and  srcatcode = 8 and posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) + ')',
	acc=(SELECT MAX(name) FROM accounts WHERE s.cashacccode = accounts.acccode),
	accounthead='Cash S/R (' + (SELECT MAX(name) FROM accounts WHERE s.cashacccode = accounts.acccode) + ')',
	priority=4
FROM
	(SELECT h.cashacccode, amt=ISNULL(Round(SUM(d.looseqty * d.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (d.looseqty * d.srprice) * (1 - (.01 * d.discperc)) * d.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (SUM((d.looseqty * d.srprice) * 	(1 - (.01 * d.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * h.discperc)) - h.flatdisc) * (h.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
			Round( SUM((d.looseqty * d.srprice) * (1 - (.01 * d.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * h.discperc)) + h.misccharges + h.salestax - h.flatdisc, 0), 0)
	FROM
		srledger h,
		srdetail d
	WHERE
		h.srinvcode = d.srinvcode and
		h.srcatcode = 8 and
		h.cashacccode IN (:ai_acccode) AND
		h.posted = 'Y' and
		h.accountfor = 'Y' and
		h.date >= :ad_StartDate and
		h.date <= :ad_EndDate
	GROUP BY h.srinvcode, h.cashacccode, 
		 h.srcatcode, 
		 h.date,
		 h.discperc,
		 h.misccharges,
		 h.salestax,
		 h.InvGSTPerc1,
		 h.flatdisc) S 
GROUP BY s.cashacccode
HAVING SUM(S.Amt) > 0
UNION ALL

	remarks='Total Invoices: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT COUNT(SRInvCode) FROM srledger WHERE srledger.cashacccode = s.cashacccode and  srcatcode IN (6, 7) and posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) +

	acc=(SELECT MAX(name) FROM accounts WHERE s.cashacccode = accounts.acccode),
	accounthead='Paid On Credit S/Return (' + (SELECT MAX(name) FROM accounts WHERE s.cashacccode = accounts.acccode) + ')',

	FROM

	WHERE
		h.srcatcode IN (6,7) and
		h.posted = 'Y' and 
		h.accountfor='Y' and

SELECT 
	glvochcode=NULL,
	Debit  = ISNULL(SUM(S.Amt), 0),
	Credit = 0,
	date = :ad_EndDate,
	type = 'CSH-SVC',
	remarks='Total Invoices: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT COUNT(ServiceInvCode) FROM serviceheader WHERE serviceheader.cashacccode = s.cashacccode and  servicecatcode = 10 and posted = 'Y' and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) + 
			' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT MIN(ServiceInvCode) FROM serviceheader WHERE serviceheader.cashacccode = s.cashacccode and  servicecatcode = 10 and posted = 'Y' and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) +
			'-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT MAX(ServiceInvCode) FROM serviceheader WHERE serviceheader.cashacccode = s.cashacccode and  servicecatcode = 10 and posted = 'Y' and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) + ')',
	acc=(SELECT MAX(name) FROM accounts WHERE s.cashacccode = accounts.acccode),
	accounthead='Cash Service Sales (' + (SELECT MAX(name) FROM accounts WHERE s.cashacccode = accounts.acccode) + ')' ,
	priority=7
FROM
	(SELECT h.cashacccode, amt=ISNULL(Case 
			When Round(sum((d.qty * d.price) * (1 - (.01 * d.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * h.discperc)) + h.misccharges - h.flatdisc, 0) IS NULL THEN 0.0
			Else Round(sum((d.qty * d.price) * (1 - (.01 * d.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * h.discperc)) + h.misccharges - h.flatdisc, 0)
			End, 0)
	FROM
		serviceheader h, 
		servicedetail d
	WHERE
		h.serviceinvcode = d.serviceinvcode and
		h.servicecatcode = 10 and
		h.posted = 'Y' and
		h.cashacccode IN (:ai_acccode) AND
		h.date >= :ad_StartDate and
		h.date <= :ad_EndDate
	GROUP BY h.serviceinvcode, h.cashacccode,
		 h.servicecatcode, 
		 h.date,
		 h.discperc,
		 h.misccharges,
		 h.flatdisc) S 
	GROUP BY s.cashacccode
	HAVING SUM(S.Amt) > 0
UNION ALL

	acc=(SELECT MAX(name) FROM accounts WHERE s.cashacccode = accounts.acccode),
	accounthead='Cr. Svc. Sale Cash (' + (SELECT MAX(name) FROM accounts WHERE s.cashacccode = accounts.acccode) + ')',
	priority=8
FROM
	(SELECT h.cashacccode, amt=ISNULL(Case 
			When Round(sum((d.qty * d.price) * (1 - (.01 * d.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * h.discperc)) + h.misccharges - h.flatdisc, 0) IS NULL THEN 0.0
			Else Round(sum((d.qty * d.price) * (1 - (.01 * d.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * h.discperc)) + h.misccharges - h.flatdisc, 0)
			End, 0)
	FROM
		serviceheader h, 
		servicedetail d
	WHERE
		h.serviceinvcode = d.serviceinvcode and
		h.servicecatcode = 12 and
		h.posted = 'Y' and
		h.cashacccode IN (:ai_acccode) AND
		h.date >= :ad_StartDate and
		h.date <= :ad_EndDate
	GROUP BY h.serviceinvcode, h.cashacccode,
		 h.servicecatcode, 
		 h.date,
		 h.discperc,
		 h.misccharges,
		 h.flatdisc) S 
GROUP BY s.cashacccode
HAVING SUM(S.Amt) > 0
UNION ALL

SELECT 
	glvochcode=NULL,
	Debit  = 0,  
	Credit = ISNULL(SUM(P.Amt), 0),
	date = :ad_EndDate,
	type = 'CSH-PUR',
	remarks='Total Invoices: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT COUNT(PurInvCode) FROM Purledger WHERE posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and amt <> 0 and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) + 
			' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT MIN(PurInvCode) FROM Purledger WHERE posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and amt <> 0 and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) +
			'-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT MAX(PurInvCode) FROM Purledger WHERE posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and amt <> 0 and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) + ')',
	acc=(SELECT MAX(name) FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode IN (:ai_acccode)),
	accounthead='Paid During Purchase for the Period',
	priority=13
FROM
	(SELECT amt=ISNULL(SUM(h.amt), 0)
	FROM
		purledger h
	WHERE
		h.posted = 'Y' and 
		h.accountfor='Y' and
		h.amt <> 0 and 
		h.date >= :ad_StartDate and
		h.date <= :ad_EndDate and
		h.paymentacccode in (:ai_acccode)) P
HAVING SUM(P.Amt) > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	glvochcode=NULL,
	Debit  = ISNULL(SUM(P.Amt), 0),
	Credit = 0,
	date = :ad_EndDate,
	type = 'CSH-PR',
	remarks='Total Invoices: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT COUNT(PrInvCode) FROM Prledger WHERE prcatcode = 4 and posted = 'Y' and accountfor = 'Y' and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) + 
			' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT MIN(PrInvCode) FROM Prledger WHERE prcatcode = 4 and posted = 'Y' and accountfor = 'Y' and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) +
			'-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT MAX(PrInvCode) FROM Prledger WHERE prcatcode = 4 and posted = 'Y' and accountfor = 'Y' and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) + ')',
	acc=(SELECT MAX(name) FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode IN (:ai_acccode)),
	accounthead='Cash P/Return for the Period',
	priority=14
FROM
	(SELECT amt=ISNULL(ROUND(SUM((d.looseqty + d.bonusqty) * d.unitsalestax) +
			SUM(ROUND(d.looseqty * d.prprice * (1 - (.01 * d.discperc)) * d.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND((SUM((d.looseqty * d.prprice) * (1 - (.01 * d.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * h.discperc)) - h.flatdisc) * (h.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
			ROUND(SUM(d.looseqty * d.prprice * (1 - (.01 * d.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * h.discperc)) + h.misccharges + h.salestax - h.flatdisc, 0), 0)
	FROM
		prledger h, 
		prdetail d
	WHERE
		h.prinvcode = d.prinvcode and
		h.prcatcode = 4 and
		h.posted = 'Y' and h.accountfor = 'Y' and
		h.date >= :ad_StartDate and
		h.date <= :ad_EndDate AND
		h.paymentacccode in (:ai_acccode)
	GROUP BY h.prinvcode,
		 h.prcatcode, 
		 h.date,
		 h.discperc,
		 h.misccharges,
		 h.salestax,
		 h.InvGSTPerc1,
		 h.flatdisc) P 
HAVING SUM(P.Amt) > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	glvochcode=NULL,
	Debit  = ISNULL(SUM(P.Amt), 0),
	Credit = 0,
	date = :ad_EndDate,

HAVING SUM(P.Amt) > 0

SELECT /*Sales Receivable Adjustments*/
	glvochcode=NULL,
	debit=SUM(d.debit),
	credit=SUM(d.credit),
	date = :ad_endDate,
	type = 'SRADJ',
	remarks='Sales Receivable Amount Adjustment',
	acc=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = d.acccode),
	accounthead=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = d.acccode),
	priority=16
FROM
	saleledger sl, salereceivableadj d, accounts a
WHERE
	sl.posted = 'Y' and
	sl.date >= :ad_StartDate and
	sl.date <= :ad_endDate and
	sl.saleinvcode = d.saleinvcode and
	d.acccode in 
		(select acccode from 
		accounts where subcode IN 
			(SELECT code FROM global 
			WHERE LOWER(name) IN 
				(LOWER('GT_CashSub')))) and
	d.acccode = a.acccode
GROUP BY
	d.acccode
UNION ALL
SELECT /*Post Dated Cheques*/
	glvochcode=notes.NoteCode,
	debit=CASE WHEN notes.NoteCatCode = 1 THEN notes.Amount ELSE 0 END,
	credit=CASE WHEN notes.NoteCatCode = 2 THEN notes.Amount ELSE 0 END,
	date = notes.PostDate,
	type = CASE WHEN notes.NoteCatCode = 1 THEN 'NR' ELSE 'NP' END + '-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(Notes.VoucherCode, 10))),
	remarks=notes.Remarks,
	acc=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = notes.BankAcccode),
	accounthead=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = notes.acccode),
	priority=17
FROM
	Notes
WHERE
	notes.posted = 'Y' and
	notes.PostDate BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_endDate and
	notes.BankAcccode IN (:ai_acccode)
UNION ALL
SELECT /*Post Dated Cheques*/
	glvochcode=notes.NoteCode,
	debit=CASE WHEN notes.NoteCatCode = 1 THEN 0 ELSE notes.Amount  END,
	credit=CASE WHEN notes.NoteCatCode = 2 THEN 0 ELSE notes.Amount  END,
	date = notes.PostDate,
	type = CASE WHEN notes.NoteCatCode = 1 THEN 'NR' ELSE 'NP' END + '-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(Notes.VoucherCode, 10))),
	remarks=notes.Remarks,
	acc=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = notes.Acccode),
	accounthead=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = notes.BankAcccode),
	priority=18
FROM
	Notes
WHERE
	notes.posted = 'Y' and
	notes.PostDate BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_endDate and
	notes.Acccode IN (:ai_acccode)
ORDER BY 
	date, 
	priority, 
	type

objects.name: c_openbalance
objects.expression: abs(cumulativeSum( debit - credit for all ) + credit - debit )

objects.name: compute_5
objects.expression: if( cumulativeSum( debit - credit for all ) + credit - debit >= 0, '', 'Cr.')

objects.name: compute_4
objects.expression: abs( cumulativeSum( debit - credit for all ) )

objects.name: compute_3
objects.expression: if( cumulativeSum( debit - credit for all ) >= 0, 'Dr.', 'Cr.')

objects.name: c_spayed
objects.expression: sum( case( remarks when 'Opening Balance' then 0 else credit) for all)

objects.name: c_sreceived
objects.expression: sum( case( remarks when 'Opening Balance' then 0 else debit) for all)

objects.name: c_currbalcrbr
objects.expression: if( cumulativeSum( debit - credit for all ) >= 0, '', 'Cr.')
